youtube.title: Why Did America Stop Eating Squirrel After 200 Years?
youtube.description:
For 200 years squirrel was everyday American food, and Joy of Cooking printed drawings showing how to skin one. So why did it vanish from the table? Not because it tasted bad. Cities turned squirrels into park pets from 1847, a Delaware farmer's 1923 chick mix-up made chicken cheap, and a 1997 brain-disease letter scared off the last holdouts. Meanwhile Britain now eats America's gray squirrel. The Hidden Why: the real reason behind the everyday things you see and use. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
